sources.evidence: The Federal Reserve Board on Friday announced the termination of the enforcement actions listed below: Gardner Bancshares, Inc., Lenexa, Kansas and Small Business Bank, Lenexa, Kansas. Cease and Desist Order dated September 1, 2023. Terminated October 13, 2026. Small Business Bank, Lenexa, Kansas. Cease and Desist Order dated November 13, 2024. Terminated October 13, 2026. Small Business Bank, Lenexa, Kansas. Prompt Corrective Action dated June 29, 2026. Terminated October 13, 2026.
